\documentclass[11pt]{article}
\usepackage{amsmath,amssymb,amsthm}
\usepackage[margin=1in]{geometry}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}
\newtheorem{lemma}[theorem]{Lemma}
\newcommand{\lean}[1]{}

\title{Halves of Even Numbers}
\author{A synthetic example}
\date{}

\begin{document}
\maketitle

\begin{lemma}\label{lem:half}\lean{Uses.half_lt}
If $n$ is even and positive, then $n/2 < n$.
\end{lemma}

\begin{theorem}\label{thm:main}\lean{Uses.main_bound}
Every even positive $n$ satisfies $n/2 < n$; in particular $4/2 < 4$.
\end{theorem}

\end{document}
